description: Create or recover a hosted Stripe payment URL after the buyer confirms the current delivery details and expected_total in SGD cents. Requires buyer_confirmed=true, current details_version and an idempotency_key retained on exact retries. Creates an unpaid order but does not charge a payment. The buyer or an authorized capable agent completes hosted Stripe checkout. get_order reports webhook-confirmed payment.

guest_token.description: Private guest session token from create_cart. Retain for cart, checkout and purchase-status calls; no account login needed.

name: prepare_payment
